skills.name: Eight Arrays
skills.text: If Zhuge Liang has no armor equipped, he has the protection of the Eight Trigrams.

skills.name: Fire Strategy
skills.text: Zhuge Liang can use any of his red hand cards as a Blaze.

skills.name: See Through
skills.text: Zhuge Liang can use any of his black hand cards as a Negate.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
